scope: Retroactive closure round for all researched municipalities. This first closure pass targets unresolved non-address-specific items from the original 42 before any new municipality is admitted. Current batch-02 municipalities remain subject to the same closure gate.

requiredBeforeBatchClosure: targeted closure search for every non-address-specific remaining item
allowedRemainingClasses: not further determinable after repeated official-source search

An omgevingsvergunning may still permit an initiative subject to spatial/woon-policy assessment. Recent 2026 plan material still references the 2024 parapluplan as part of the applicable framework.
closedNonAddressItems: existence and substantive direction of current municipal anti-room-rental/splitting spatial regime
remaining: address-specific current Omgevingsplan applicability and permit output

qualityRule: No municipality is declared fully closed merely because a search failed. Failed repeated official-source search is explicitly classified as not-further-determinable, while address/dynamic outputs remain separate.
